newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Imasco medium-term A rating.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Imasco medium-term A rating.

text.p: The Canadian Bond Rating Service reaffirmed its A rating on Monday for Imasco Ltd's medium-term notes, Euro-notes and unsecured debentures.
The CBRS also upgraded Imasco's commercial paper rating to A-1 from A-1 (low) and jumped the company's preferred share rating to P-2 (high) from P-2.
Imperial Tobacco and Canada Trust, which account for almost 90 percent of Imasco's operating earnings, are performing well and provide strong credit support, the CBRS said in support of its decision.
